R9 (CLOSED 2026-11-25, NEX-010): the OIDC token verifier had no direct test; no file under tests/ imported infrastructure/identity/oidc_relying_party and every login test injected FakeRelyingParty. Now pinned by tests/authentication/test_oidc_relying_party.py (21 tests, real in-process RSA keys, only the JWKS lookup stubbed), each guard proved load-bearing by mutation, and green in CI at 0fcc078. Writing it found and fixed a real defect: a non-ASCII nonce claim raised TypeError out of secrets.compare_digest on str, so a hostile token produced a 500 instead of a refusal. Residual: the JWKS client itself is still stubbed, so network key discovery remains untested by design.
